CVE-2026-21726 is a path traversal in the Loki server Ruler API (`/loki/api/v1/rules/{namespace}` namespace validation). This image ships only the promtail client built from `./clients/cmd/promtail`; it does not expose the Ruler HTTP surface or execute the affected server-side handlers. Grafana fixed the issue in Loki 3.6.4; the catalog continues to publish a maintained 3.5.x line per upstream tags without retargeting that release line to 3.6.x.
